channel.description: Regional headlines in English, updated four times a day.

item.title: Uzbekistan discusses strengthening public-private partnerships against digital terrorism
item.description: A two-day seminar in Uzbekistan focused on enhancing cooperation between law enforcement and tech companies to counter terrorism in the digital space. Organized within the framework of the Uzbekistan-UNCTED Roadmap, the event involved government bodies, ministries, and ICT companies. Discussions centered on improving state-private sector interaction to combat the use of new technologies for terrorist purposes and respond to online incidents.

item.title: Uzbekistan's business environment evolution over 35 years of independence
item.description: Over 35 years of independence, Uzbekistan has transitioned from a Soviet-type economy to a model emphasizing private property, entrepreneurship, and market competition. This economic transformation occurred in stages: formation of national economy foundations (1991-1996), gradual development of small business (1997-2016), large-scale liberalization (since 2017), and the current phase focused on reducing state role, privatization, and digitalization.

item.title: Kyrgyz court denies journalist Mahabat Tajiibek kyzy travel for prestigious award ceremony
item.description: A court in Bishkek denied Kyrgyz journalist Mahabat Tajiibek kyzy permission to travel to London to receive The Albies award. The Committee to Protect Journalists and the International Press Institute urged Kyrgyzstan to drop charges against her, citing concerns for press freedom. CPJ stated that Kyrgyzstan has an opportunity to rectify damage to its international reputation by allowing her to work freely.

item.title: Uzbekistan Launches New Environmental Initiatives: Investing in Nature Restoration
item.description: Uzbekistan held an event in Ulaanbaatar during a UN conference on desertification, focusing on "From Investment to Results." Discussions covered restoring degraded lands, enhancing climate resilience, and attracting investment for ecological solutions. Advisor to the President Aziz Abdukhakimov highlighted successful projects in Karakalpakstan, funded by the Abu Dhabi Fund for Development, demonstrating the impact of targeted investments.

item.title: Kazakhstan Police Implement New Rules for Electric Scooters, Restricting Sidewalk Use
item.description: As of August 25, electric scooters are banned from sidewalks and pedestrian paths in Kazakhstan. Police will monitor compliance using surveillance cameras, technical devices, and drones. Mobile police units on scooters will also patrol urban areas. The Ministry of Internal Affairs has notified shared scooter companies of the new regulations, which aim to improve safety following 139 accidents involving scooters this year.

item.title: Uzbekistan Enhances Citizen Complaint System in the Energy Sector
item.description: Uzbekistan is improving its system for handling citizen complaints in the energy sector, emphasizing timely problem identification and effective solutions. A training seminar for responsible employees focused on enhancing communication skills, problem-solving, and ethical conduct. The initiative aims to ensure a high level of responsibility and thorough examination of each citizen's request.

item.title: Central Asia International Education Forum Preparations Underway in Tashkent
item.description: Tashkent will host the Central Asia International Education Forum from October 27-30. A coordination meeting involving the Ministry of Higher Education, Science, and Innovation, along with leading universities, discussed preparatory measures and task distribution. A step-by-step action plan was approved to ensure the forum's high-level organization and strengthen inter-university cooperation.
